steps.instruction: Raw QC on strainA: `pixi run sequali -t 8 data/raw/strainA_R1.fq.gz data/raw/strainA_R2.fq.gz -o sequali_raw results/strainA/qc_raw/strainA.html`
accept: pixi run sequali -t 8 data/raw/strainA_R1.fq.gz data/raw/strainA_R2.fq.gz -o sequali_raw results/strainA/qc_raw/strainA.html
steps.note: Checkpoint is reading the HTML (Q30 %, adapter signal) - the agent discusses the recorded report, the student answers in chat.

steps.instruction: Trim strainA: `pixi run fastp -i data/raw/strainA_R1.fq.gz -I data/raw/strainA_R2.fq.gz -o results/strainA/trimmed/strainA_R1.trimmed.fq.gz -O results/strainA/trimmed/strainA_R2.trimmed.fq.gz --qualified_quality_phred 20 --length_required 50 --detect_adapter_for_pe --thread 8 --html results/strainA/qc/fastp.strainA.html --json results/strainA/qc/fastp.strainA.json`
accept: pixi run fastp -i data/raw/strainA_R1.fq.gz -I data/raw/strainA_R2.fq.gz -o results/strainA/trimmed/strainA_R1.trimmed.fq.gz -O results/strainA/trimmed/strainA_R2.trimmed.fq.gz --qualified_quality_phred 20 --length_required 50 --detect_adapter_for_pe --thread 8 --html results/strainA/qc/fastp.strainA.html --json results/strainA/qc/fastp.strainA.json

pixi run fastp -i data/raw/strainA_R1.fq.gz -I data/raw/strainA_R2.fq.gz --qualified_quality_phred 20 --length_required 50 --detect_adapter_for_pe --thread 8 --html results/strainA/qc/fastp.strainA.html --json results/strainA/qc/fastp.strainA.json -o results/strainA/trimmed/strainA_R1.trimmed.fq.gz -O results/strainA/trimmed/strainA_R2.trimmed.fq.gz
steps.note: Second accept form is genuine fastp flexibility (output flags may trail the report flags); the checkpoint - how many reads survived - comes from the fastp HTML, not the buffer.

steps.instruction: Re-QC the trimmed reads (same as step 1, changed inputs): `pixi run sequali -t 8 results/strainA/trimmed/strainA_R1.trimmed.fq.gz results/strainA/trimmed/strainA_R2.trimmed.fq.gz -o sequali_trimmed results/strainA/qc_trimmed/strainA.html`
Raph troubleshooting (no trimming yet): `pixi run sequali -t 8 data/raw/Raph_R1.fq.gz data/raw/Raph_R2.fq.gz -o sequali_raw results/Raph/qc_raw/Raph.html`
accept: pixi run sequali -t 8 data/raw/Raph_R1.fq.gz data/raw/Raph_R2.fq.gz -o sequali_raw results/Raph/qc_raw/Raph.html
steps.note: A CRASH IS THE EXPECTED OUTCOME for the Raph drill (Windows/WSL I/O fault reproducibility test). An error here routes to the discussion branch - 'the Linux-native rerun is the decisive test' - never to the generic error branch.

steps.instruction: Aggregate everything so far: `pixi run multiqc results/ --force -o results/multiqc`
